# OmniKey AI

> OmniKey AI is a free, open-source (MIT) desktop tool for macOS and Windows that enhances
> prompts, fixes grammar, and runs custom AI tasks on whatever text you have selected, in any
> application, triggered by a keyboard shortcut. Bring your own model: OpenAI, Anthropic,
> Google Gemini, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

OmniKey runs locally as a background daemon plus a menu bar app (macOS) or system tray app
(Windows). Select text in any app, press a shortcut, and the result is pasted back in place.
No copy-paste, no separate chat tab, no subscription.

## Core shortcuts

- `⌘E` / `Ctrl+E` — Enhance Prompt. Rewrites selected text with better clarity, structure, and tone.
- `⌘G` / `Ctrl+G` — Grammar & Clarity. Fixes spelling, grammar, and readability without changing meaning.
- `⌘T` / `Ctrl+T` — Custom Task or Agent. Applies your saved task instructions, or runs OmniAgent.

## Inline commands

- `@omnikeyai <instruction>` — ad-hoc instruction applied to the selected text.
- `@omniAgent <instruction>` — hands the task to the autonomous agent, which has terminal
  access, web search, authenticated browser reading, and any configured MCP server.

## Install

- macOS (Homebrew): `brew tap GurinderRawala/omnikey-ai https://github.com/GurinderRawala/OmniKey-AI.git && brew install omnikey-cli`
- Cross-platform (npm): `npm install -g omnikey-cli`
- One-line macOS: `curl -fsSL https://omnikeyai.ca/install.sh | bash`
- One-line Windows: `iwr -useb https://omnikeyai.ca/install.ps1 | iex`

Then: `omnikey onboard` to configure a provider, `omnikey daemon` to run it persistently.

## Key capabilities

- Multiple LLM providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenAI-compatible open models.
- MCP servers over stdio, HTTP, or SSE. The agent discovers and calls tools automatically.
- Web search via DuckDuckGo, Serper, Brave Search, Tavily, or SearXNG.
- Authenticated browser sessions so the agent can read logged-in pages.
- Telegram bridge for running tasks and receiving results from any device.
- Scheduled jobs for recurring prompt runs.
- Works in every application: editors, browsers, mail clients, chat apps, terminals.

## Comparisons

- vs. Grammarly: OmniKey works in any app with any model you choose, is MIT licensed, and
  sends text only to the provider you configure.
- vs. Raycast AI: no subscription, available on Windows as well as macOS, fully inspectable source.
- vs. ChatGPT desktop apps: no context switching into a chat tab; the rewrite happens in place.
